camel_example: aliyun live AddLivePackageConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName StreamName --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Protocol HLS_CMAF --AppName AppName
description_en: You can call the AddLivePackageConfig operation to add a live stream packaging configuration
description_zh: 调用AddLivePackageConfig添加直播封装配置
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-package-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name AppName --stream-name StreamName --protocol HLS_CMAF --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLivePackageConfig

parameters.help_en: The live streaming domain name. This is the primary playback domain name
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The AppName must match the AppName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. The AppName can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). A hyphen or an underscore cannot be the first character. You can also set this parameter to a single asterisk (*) to match all AppNames
parameters.help_zh: AppName 名称与推流地址中的 AppName 名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The StreamName must match the StreamName in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. The StreamName can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). A hyphen or an underscore cannot be the first character. You can also set this parameter to a single asterisk (*) to match all StreamNames
parameters.help_zh: StreamName 名称与推流地址中的 StreamName 名称对应，模板才能生效。不超过255字符，支持数字、大小写字母、短横线（-）、下划线（_），短横线、下划线不能位于首位。也支持取值为单个星号（*）字符，即可匹配所有StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The live streaming protocol and container format. Valid values:

HLS_CMAF

LLHLS_TS
  (low latency)

LLHLS_CMAF (low latency)

DASH_CMAF

HLSDASH_CMAF
parameters.help_zh:
直播协议与封装格式。取值：

HLS_CMAF

LLHLS_TS
（低延迟）

LLHLS_CMAF（低延迟）
DASH_CMAF
HLSDASH_CMAF
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The number of M3U8 segments for live streaming.

Valid values: 3 to 10.

Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh:
直播M3U8切片个数。

取值范围：3～10。

默认值：3
parameters.name: segment_num

parameters.help_en:
The segment length, in seconds.

If you set Protocol to HLS_CMAF, the valid values are 1 to 10. The default value is 5.

If you set Protocol to LLHLS_*, the valid values are 1 to 2. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh:
切片时长，单位：秒。

如Protocol为HLS_CMAF，取值范围1～10，默认5秒；

如Protocol为LLHLS_*，取值范围1～2，默认1秒
parameters.name: segment_duration

parameters.help_en:
The length of the part segment, in milliseconds.

If SegmentDuration is 1 s, the valid values are 100 to 500. The default value is 350.

If SegmentDuration is 2 s, the valid values are 100 to 1000. The default value is 700.

This parameter is valid only when you set Protocol to LLHLS_*
parameters.help_zh:
Part切片时长，单位：毫秒。

SegmentDuration为1s时，取值范围100～500ms，默认350ms。

SegmentDuration为2s时，取值范围100～1000ms，默认700ms。

仅当Protocol为LLHLS_*时有效
parameters.name: part_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore transcoded streams. Valid values:

true (default): Ignore transcoded streams.

false: Do not ignore transcoded streams
parameters.help_zh:
是否忽略转码流，取值：

true（默认值）：忽略。

false：不忽略
parameters.name: ignore_transcode
